Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As a developer, I want a working Redmine plugin skeleton so I can add logic incrementally.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Generate a new Redmine plugin (redmine_jira_bridge) with init.rb, lib/, app/, db/migrate. Add minimal dependencies and a startup log.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Plugin installs via rake redmine:plugins:migrate
- Visible in Redmine → Administration → Plugins
- Logs 'Plugin initialized' at startup

Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As the system, I need to detect when an issue status becomes 'Accepted' so I can trigger Jira creation.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Implement a hook listener (controller_issues_edit_after_save) to check journal details for status_id change to configured value; verify acting user role.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Fires once when status becomes 'Accepted'
- Records issue id and actor in logs
- Does not fire if the issue already has a Jira key

Summary: Global admin settings for Jira connection and defaults
Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As an admin, I want to configure Jira base URL, credentials, and mapping defaults globally.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Add a plugin settings page with fields: Jira URL, email, API token, accepted status ID, allowed roles, default issue type.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Settings saved and retrievable via Setting.plugin_redmine_jira_bridge[...]
- Invalid config shows validation message
- Sensitive credentials masked

Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As the plugin, I need to connect to Jira to create issues.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Create JiraClient using basic auth (email + API token) and POST /rest/api/3/issue with JSON payload. Handle 4xx/5xx and network errors with clear messages.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Successful test issue creation to a sandbox project
- Non-2xx responses raise a typed error
- HTTP calls are unit-testable and stubbed

Summary: Map Redmine fields to Jira payload
Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As a developer, I want a mapping layer from Redmine Issue fields to Jira Issue fields.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Create JiraPayloadBuilder mapping subject, description, priority, labels; include link back to the Redmine issue; support JSON-configured custom field mappings.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Payload validates mandatory Jira fields before send
- Priority mapping table applied (Redmine → Jira)
- Customfield_* mappings supported via JSON

Summary: Enqueue background job for Jira issue creation
Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As a developer, I want Jira creation to be async so UI stays responsive.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Create JiraCreateJob (ActiveJob) with retries/backoff for transient errors; logs start/success/failure.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Job enqueued on Accepted event
- Retry policy covers network/5xx errors
- Structured logs for observability

Summary: Persist Jira key on Redmine issue and add journal note
Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As a Redmine user, I want to see the Jira key and link on the issue.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Save Jira key to a custom field (or column) and add journal entry with a browse link.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Jira key visible on issue show view
- Journal records creation with link
- Re-runs don’t duplicate or overwrite without explicit action

Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As a project admin, I want to set the Jira Project Key and defaults per Redmine project.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Add Project → Settings → Jira tab with: Jira Project Key, default issue type, enable/disable toggle; inherit from global settings with overrides.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Settings stored per project
- Disable toggle prevents new Jira creations
- Defaults inherited cleanly when unset

Summary: Define permissions and role gate for triggering
Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As an admin, I want only specific roles to trigger Jira creation by changing status.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Introduce project module :jira_bridge with permissions :trigger_jira_creation and :view_jira_link; enforce role gate in trigger logic.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Only users with allowed role can trigger
- View permission controls Jira key visibility
- Permissions appear in project role settings

Summary: Add sync logs and status visibility
Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As an admin, I want to see whether Jira creation succeeded or failed for each issue.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Create jira_sync_logs table to store payload/response/status; show latest status in the issue sidebar; record failures in journal.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Log entry created for each sync attempt
- Latest status visible on issue page
- Failure messages include actionable details

Summary: Test suite: mapping, client, trigger, and integration
Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As a developer, I want automated tests to prevent regressions.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Use RSpec/minitest with WebMock/VCR; cover payload mapping, client error handling, trigger logic, and an end-to-end flow with stubbed Jira.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Unit tests pass locally
- >90% coverage on service classes
- Integration test simulates status change → job → stored Jira key

Summary: Enhancements: webhook back-sync & manual create button
Creator: WuSizhe
Description:
h2. User Story
    As a user/admin, I want extra capabilities for control and synchronization.

    h2. Proposed Solution
    Add an endpoint for Jira webhooks to reflect updates in Redmine; add a 'Create Jira now' button for manual control; consider Sidekiq/Resque adapters.

    h2. Acceptance Criteria
    - Webhook endpoint receives and logs events
- Manual action creates Jira even without Accepted status
- Background job adapter configurable
